Good to know

The avatar chat is an interactive, AI-powered experience. It is not a live person and does not provide diagnosis or treatment. The group and one-on-one options are live sessions with Dr. Kim.

If you are in crisis

These services are not for emergencies. If someone is in immediate danger, call 911. If you are thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) any time.
